title: Sectionwise base change assembles to the sheafified ring-family comparison
statement: Let (C,J,O) be a small commutative ringed site, A its global ring, and T its explicit scalar-extension functor [def-weil-pbc-global-section-scalar-extension]. Fix a strictly functorial augmented ring-complex family (K,epsilon,m,hm) [def-weil-pbc-ring-complex-cech-data], with augmented ordered Cech models for every ring and finitely generated ideal. For a finite global list f, put I=(f) in A. Let p:P to K(A,I) be a quasi-isomorphism with P K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex]. The canonical map q:T(P) to ringFamilySheafModel(O,K,epsilon,m,hm,f) [def-weil-pbc-functorial-ring-complex-sheaf], obtained by extending m(phi_X) composed with p and sheafifying, is a quasi-isomorphism. Its composite with the target augmentation equals the explicit extended augmentation of p composed with epsilon(A,I). The ring derived categories are assumed in one common hom universe; no derived category of sheaves is needed for this chain-level assertion.

proof.text: Ideal evaluation identifies I O(X) with the ideal generated by f_i(X). Compose p in degree n with m for evaluation A to O(X). The composition equation of hm gives restriction naturality, and its differential equation gives the chain-map condition. The constant-presheaf/pullback adjunction extends this chain map. Apply sheafification to obtain the concrete map q. The Lean definitions ringFamilyGlobalRestrictedTerm, ringFamilyGlobalRestrictedMap and ringFamilyGlobalComparison implement these operations without postponed data.

Transport the global augmented Cech model backwards across p. For every X, ringComplexExtendAlong gives the normalized scalar-extension map. Its pure-tensor formula and the augmentation clause of hm meet the hypotheses of the augmented ring Cech base-change theorem, so that map is a quasi-isomorphism. This is the proved theorem ringFamilyGlobalSectionComparison_quasiIso in the same module.

Construct the module presheaf whose value at X is O(X) tensor_A P^n, with restriction b tensor x mapping to the restriction of b tensor the restriction of x. The sectionwise extension/restriction adjunction gives tensorHomEquiv and tensorAdjunction. Uniqueness of left adjoints gives tensorPullbackIso with the existing abstract pullback. Naturality of adjoint transposition and tensorPushAdjunction_symm_tmul identify the evaluated comparison with ringComplexExtendAlong, using ringComplexExtensionSections as a degreewise isomorphism of complexes. The preceding step therefore gives an objectwise quasi-isomorphism. The faithful exact functor to additive presheaves and objectwise homology detect this presheaf quasi-isomorphism; exact module sheafification preserves it. These steps are implemented in globalComparison_quasiIso. Empty sites have no evaluations, so the same argument applies.

For the augmentation, morphisms into the complex concentrated in degree zero are determined by degree zero. Transpose the proposed equality across sheafification and pullback. Naturality cancels the two adjunctions; globalUnit_transpose_apply identifies the transposed extension unit with evaluation of global sections. The resulting equality is precisely hm.2.1. This proves globalComparison_augmentation. Pair it with globalComparison_quasiIso. Empty, zero or repeated generator lists use the unchanged ideal-map and augmentation formulas.

lean.statement:
theorem ringFamilyGlobalExtension_to_family
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    [∀ A : CommRingCat.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (RingSiteModules A)]
    (K : RingComplexFamily.{u}) (ε : RingComplexAugmentations K)
    (m : RingComplexMaps K) (hm : RingComplexFunctorial K ε m)
    (hK : ∀ (A : CommRingCat.{u}) (I : {I : Ideal A // I.FG}),
      RingComplexHasCechModel A I.val (K A I) (ε A I))
    (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → (O.obj ⋙ forget CommRingCat).sections)
    (P : CochainComplex (RingSiteModules (ringFamilyGlobalRing O)) ℤ)
    (p : P ⟶ K (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) (ringFamilyGlobalIdeal O r f))
    (hp : QuasiIso p) (hflat : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients) :
    QuasiIso (ringFamilyGlobalComparison O K ε m hm r f P p) ∧
      ringFamilyGlobalComparison O K ε m hm r f P p ≫
        (ringFamilySheafModel O K ε m hm r f).2 =
        ringFamilyGlobalExtensionAugmentation O
          (p ≫ ε (ringFamilyGlobalRing O) (ringFamilyGlobalIdeal O r f))
